svg.aria-label: Profile card. About: Junior Full-Stack Developer who builds modern web applications and LLM-powered solutions, architecting the future one component at a time. Stack: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Next.js, Vite, Svelte, Node.js, Express, FastAPI, Python, PHP, SQLite, Drizzle ORM. Credentials: IBM Full-Stack Software Developer Professional Certificate (Coursera, July 2026), ASEAN AI Hackathon 2026 Certificate (Passage to ASEAN, June 2026), BSIT Cum Laude from Tarlac Agricultural University (2026). Bonus: GitHub Pull Shark, Starstruck x2, YOLO.

g.text: N O W P L A Y I N G
I’m a Junior Full-Stack Developer who builds modern web applications and
LLM-powered solutions. I enjoy turning ambitious ideas into practical,
well-structured software. I value clean engineering, thoughtful user
experiences, and scalable architecture, continuously deepening my understanding
of how software works. I’m constantly learning, building, and
ARCHITECTING THE FUTURE ONE COMPONENT AT A TIME.
C R E D E N T I A L S
IBM Full-Stack Software Developer Professional Certificate
